description_en: Queries whether the related service-linked role is created for Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) in the current account
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）是否已授权服务关联角色
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-service-linked-role-exists --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine Redis --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServiceLinkedRoleExists

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the instance resides.

This parameter does not affect the query results. You can specify any region ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的地域ID。
该参数不影响查询结果，配置任意地域即可
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The database engine of the instance. Only Redis is supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据库类型。仅支持传入“Redis”或不传本参数
parameters.name: engine

ExistsServiceLinkedRole.description_en:
Indicates whether the service-linked role is created for Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) in the current account. Valid values:

true
false
ExistsServiceLinkedRole.description_zh:
当前账号是否已经开通了角色。返回值：

true：已开通。

false：未开通

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
